identity.title: Lock scope conflict positive and negative controls

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Use production-derived scoped evidence plus bounded canonical test variants to prove the exact conflict boundary: differing decisions across distinct scopes are not conflicts, while contradictory decisions inside the same scope/domain remain visible.
human_pressure.why_now: The original EverRun dogfood failure was a run-wide false positive. The repaired rule must be protected against both regression directions: reintroducing false positives or suppressing true conflicts.
do_not_misread: This is a two-sided regression control, not new conflict semantics.
Do not broaden conflict vocabulary beyond already implemented decision semantics.
red_lines: No conflict suppression by producer identity.

machine_core.goal: Prove scope-aware decision consistency with paired negative and positive controls anchored in the real failure class.
red_lines: Do not alter source evidence expectations after observing results.
Do not add new top-level governance concepts.
invariants: Cross-scope decision differences alone do not yield evidence_inconsistency.
Same-scope contradictory execution-control decisions remain detectable.
Unknown scope is not silently assigned to make a test pass.

producer.artifact: production-derived multi-scope evidence and bounded canonical conflict control

observable_effect.assertion: Negative control stays clean of false conflict while positive same-scope control still emits the existing inconsistency signal.

proofs.assertion: Both control directions pass focused tests and full suite.

failure_semantics: Cross-scope conflict is a false-positive regression.
Missing same-scope conflict is a false-negative regression.

steps.title: Bind negative control to real incident class
details: Use distinct scopes with differing decisions and assert no false inconsistency.

steps.title: Bind positive control
details: Use same scope and projected domain with contradictory existing decision semantics and assert evidence_inconsistency remains.

steps.title: Verify provenance
details: Ensure any emitted conflict signal points to the conflicting source evidence refs.

acceptance: Cross-scope negative control produces no false conflict.

must_check: Both positive and negative controls exist.
The controls reflect the production failure class rather than arbitrary invented policy.
reject_if: Only one side of the control is tested.
